title.zh: NP02 回执兄弟 PTX 实体回补（47 份）+ .ptx 属性固化
title.en: Restore the 47 receipt-sibling PTX entities for NP02 and pin the .ptx attributes

intent.zh: NP02 回执重算（`2026-11-03-precision-np02-receipt-rehash`）定位到 51 份回执在约定兄弟路径缺 PTX 实体：其中 47 份的实体在仓内其它目录存在且 sha256 等于回执 `ptxSha256`。回执 JSON 无路径字段（扫描器按 `<entry>-<ptxSha256>.ptx` 兄弟文件解析），因此无法「改回执指向」，只能把已有同 sha 实体复制回约定路径（复制前后逐一复核 sha256，不伪造内容）。另在 `docs/development-evidence/.gitattributes` 加 `*.ptx -text -diff`，避免 `core.autocrlf=true` 检出时 PTX 行尾被转换、导致实体哈希与回执不符。剩余 4 份按文件名全仓 0 命中，已标 historical-unrecoverable-filename，不在本卡补造。
intent.en: The NP02 rehash found 51 receipts missing their sibling PTX entity; 47 of those entities exist elsewhere in the repo with sha256 equal to the receipt ptxSha256. Receipts carry no path field, so the scanner convention requires the entity at the sibling path: copy the identical-hash entity back (verify sha256 before/after, no fabrication). Also add `*.ptx -text -diff` under docs/development-evidence/ so core.autocrlf cannot rewrite PTX line endings and break entity hashes.

acceptance: 47 个实体逐个复制到回执兄弟路径 `<entry>-<ptxSha256>.ptx`，复制前后 sha256 与回执 `ptxSha256` 一致；逐条来源/字节/sha 记录在 `docs/development-evidence/np02-evidence/rehash-2026-11-04/missing-capture-restore.json`（已随 NP02 收口提交 3f747504 入库）。

`docs/development-evidence/.gitattributes` 含 `*.ptx -text -diff`；跑 `scripts/np02-evidence/np02-evidence.ps1` 后 `receipt_ptx_entities_verified` 650→697、`receipt_ptx_entities_missing` 51→4（与 NP02 清单一致）。
不补造：4 份按文件名不存在的实体（small_prefix_factor_{3,4,5,6}）保持缺失并标记，不复制同 sha 等价副本（owner 2026-11-04 指令）。
边界：只新增 `docs/development-evidence/layers-m3-*/**/*.ptx` 47 个文件与 `docs/development-evidence/.gitattributes`；`src/`、`tests/`、`fixtures/`、判据/容差/参考零改动。
note: QA 2026-11-04 注册。拆分原因：NP02 卡 `2026-11-03-precision-np02-receipt-rehash` 的 schedule.files 只覆盖 `docs/development-evidence/np02-evidence/`、`scripts/np02-evidence/`、`tests/precision_evidence_gate.rs`，实体回补要写回各原捕获目录（layers-m3-*），commit-msg 钩子按先例报 `E commit/scope 超出任务范围`；不绕过门禁、不改已关闭卡的冻结字段，故按 S7b1/G10 拆分先例把「实体回补 + 属性固化」独立成片。清单/README/收据已在 3f747504 落库。
